# SOLAR Session Logs

<!-- Activated when `"logging": true` in `.github/solar.config.json`. Contains only `.gitkeep` by default. -->

Per-session activity log files are created at runtime when `"logging": true` is set in `solar.config.json`. This folder contains only `.gitkeep` by default; runtime log files are gitignored.

To enable session logging, set `"logging": true` in `.github/solar.config.json`.
